customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be among the best in the market, with excellent installation, premium appearance, and good water quality that makes a noticeable difference. Moreover, the service receives positive feedback, with one customer noting the technical expertise of the service team. However, opinions about value for money are mixed, with some finding it worth the price while others say not to buy it. Additionally, reliability and taste receive mixed reviews, with some reporting it works perfectly while others say it doesn't work properly, and some praising the taste while others find it bad.
